@d3plus/core dev pages

charts / BarChart

  • BarChart Basic BarChart with a long category label and a custom fontFamily.
  • AxisBreaks Axis breaks on bar and line charts (baseline breaks, outlier breaks, masks, horizontal bars) with an SVG/Canvas toggle.
  • DrillMorph Click a bar to drill into its sub-categories; children grow out of the clicked bar (issue #166).
  • Labels Bar labels when every bar has the same value, with a timeline.
  • PopulationPyramid Horizontal stacked BarChart drawn as a population pyramid, with a timeline.

charts / BoxWhisker

  • BoxWhisker BoxWhisker chart of two groups with outliers.

charts / BumpChart

  • BumpChart BumpChart of fruit rankings over three years with line labels.

charts / Chord

  • Chord Directed Chord diagram from links; commented variants cover undirected, arrows, self-loops and explicit nodes.

charts / Gauge

  • Gauge Gauge needle, progress, multi-needle, multi-ring and canvas variants, with an animated needle.

charts / Geomap

  • Geomap US state choropleth of diabetes prevalence with a basemap tile switcher.
  • Coords Point data on the US counties topojson with a timeline.
  • Counties US county choropleth with a bucketed colorScale and the geoAlbersUsaTerritories projection.
  • FakeSales Points at state coordinates over basemap tiles, colored by sales with a date timeline.
  • Hexgrid US states hexgrid topojson with a colorScale, custom labels and no tiles.
  • SizeLegend World cities sized by population; zooming relabels the size legend.
  • Tiles Switch between basemap tile providers on a world map.
  • TopojsonRequest Loads topojson through a request object (POST with headers and a body) and colors states by population.

charts / Histogram

  • Histogram Histogram defaults, stacked groups, binWidth and density normalization.

charts / LinePlot

  • ColorScale LinePlot whose lines are colored by a colorScale of each series' latest value.
  • Confidence LinePlot with confidence bands on a discrete time axis.
  • Domain Fixed x domain that resets to the data extent after 3 seconds.
  • LineLabels Line labels on observed and predicted series; more predictions arrive after 2 seconds.
  • Monthly Monthly time axis spanning three decades of bank deposits.
  • Predictions Observed and predicted series as separate lines, with a title and subtitle.
  • ShapeSort Thick labeled lines whose stacking order comes from shapeConfig.sort.
  • Sparkline A row of small sparkline LinePlots.

charts / Matrix

  • Matrix Continent-to-continent trade Matrix with a jenks colorScale and axis titles.

charts / Network

  • Network Network with positioned nodes, links, and data merged onto the nodes.
  • ForceLayout Force-directed Network from nodes without coordinates, with sized links.
  • IndustrySpace Large positioned Network (Brazilian CNAE industry space) colored by sector.
  • ProductSpace Product space: the HS4 network colored by section, using trade data.
  • SizeLegend Force-directed Network sized by value; zooming relabels the size legend.

charts / Pack

  • Pack Basic nested Pack chart.
  • DrillMorph Click a circle to drill in; children grow out of the clicked circle (issue #166).

charts / Pie

  • Pie Pie with a nested groupBy shown at its top depth.
  • DrillMorph Click a wedge to drill in; children grow out of the clicked wedge (issue #166).

charts / Plot

  • Annotations Rect annotations drawn behind and in front of a LinePlot.
  • AnnotationsExit Scatter with line annotations on log/linear axes; the annotations exit in two steps.
  • Buffers Axis buffers on and off for Bar, Circle and Line shapes.
  • LabelBounds Scatter of top songs with custom labelBounds placing labels beside each mark.
  • LegendInset Legends, size legends and colorScales placed inside empty plot corners.
  • Logo Animated d3plus logo built from Plot annotations.
  • MixedShapes Plot mixing Bar and Line shapes with line markers and labels on a discrete axis.
  • SecondaryAxes LinePlot with a secondary y2 axis.
  • SharedTooltip Shared crosshair tooltips across LinePlot, StackedArea and BarChart variants (issue #779).
  • SizeLegend Size legend placement in the plot margins beside legends and colorScales.
  • TimeAxes Yearly and monthly time axes on BarChart and LinePlot.
  • TrendLines Linear, polynomial and exponential trend lines with confidence bands across chart types.
  • TrendProjections Trend line projections into future periods, with fans and custom projectionConfig.

  • Priestley Priestley timeline with a custom start accessor.

  • Radar Radar chart of two groups across six metrics.

  • RadialMatrix Continent-to-continent trade RadialMatrix with a jenks colorScale.

charts / Rings

charts / Sankey

  • Sankey Basic Sankey from nodes and weighted links.
  • CsvLinks Multi-step Sankey built from a CSV edge list with custom source/target keys.

charts / StackedArea

  • StackedArea Narrow StackedArea with a zero value, a nested groupBy and date strings.

charts / Tree

  • Tree Horizontal Tree with mixed Rect and Circle nodes.

charts / Treemap

  • Treemap Nested Treemap loaded from JSON, drawn with the canvas renderer.
  • DrillMorph Click a cell to drill in; children grow out of the clicked cell (issue #166). Includes a zoom toggle.
  • Images Treemap cells filled with background images.
  • Large Treemap of US state populations with a timeline.

charts / Viz

  • Viz Base Viz chrome: title, total, legend and timeline.
  • DetectVisible 200 charts on one page, each rendered only once it scrolls into view.
  • DetectVisibleUnload detectVisible unloading of off-screen charts, with a live status panel.
  • FontLoading Charts re-measure their text after a web font finishes loading.
  • Iframe The Treemap page rendered inside an iframe.
  • LinkedCharts Linked Treemap, BarChart and LinePlot sharing hover and highlight.
  • ScrollingPage Charts between paragraphs of a scrolling page.
  • Search Label search control: layout beside the back button, long titles, styling, match cycling and searchAccessor.
  • TableView Data table view virtualization and pagination with up to 20,000 rows.
  • Timeline Viz timeline with brushing and a default range selection.
  • Zoom Zoom controls across chart types and renderers, with custom icons.
  • ZoomControlStyles Zoom control styling with plain buttons and Bootstrap, Tailwind, Bulma and Mantine-like classes.

components / Axis

  • Axis Standalone AxisLeft with a point scale, outlined by its outer bounds.
  • LabelRotation Ordinal AxisLeft with labelRotation(false), outlined by its outer bounds.

  • Log Log scale axes across a domain that spans zero.
  • Quarters Quarterly time axis in the ar-SA locale.
  • Rounding Linear axis rounding: inside, none and outside.
  • Time Yearly, monthly and daily time axes, with and without data ticks.
